name: cookie_notice
title: Cookie Notice
summary: Cookie consent bar at the bottom of every page.
description: Cookie consent bar fixed to the bottom of every page (rendered by page_constructor). Text, button and the privacy page link come from data_content_cookie_notice.json. Accepting stores the choice (localStorage + cookie) so the bar stays hidden; changing "version" shows it again. Fires a cookie-notice:accept event on document.
